Holds the index of current effective not masked event. The index is valid for reading as long as the event is active*. Once event handling is done (either trigering scr/ctx or not) this field holds last active event.
*) An Active event is an event that is handles by h/w in one of the following ways: An non-mask event, for specific current PHY STATE, can be "non-valid", "valid and not executable" or "valid and exeutable" by scripter/cortex.
If event is "non-valid" if INVALID_EVENT_EN = 1 it will trigger the cortex - index is held till cortex is done and event gets cleared. if INVALID_EVENT_EN = 0 it will only change PHY STATE to next state and event gets cleared. Else if "event is not executable" it will only change PHY State to next state - this field holds event index for few cycles till event gets cleared. Else ("valid and executable") It will trigger cortex/scripter. index is held till cortex/scripter are done and event gets cleared.
